Plot Functional Abundance Boxplots for Driving Taxa

tax2fun_box.Rd

This function generates boxplots of stratified functional pathway abundances (from PICRUSt2 output) at a specified taxonomic level for each driving taxon, grouped by a metadata variable.

Usage

tax2fun_box(
  stratified_path,
  pathway_sdaa_result,
  physeq,
  taxon_level = NULL,
  group,
  kegg_map = NULL
)

Arguments

stratified_path

Path to the stratified output file from PICRUSt2 (typically `*_strat.tsv`).

pathway_sdaa_result

A named list of data.frames containing differential results (with `feature` and optionally `pathway_name`) for each taxon.

physeq

A `phyloseq` object containing the microbial abundance table, taxonomy, and sample metadata.

taxon_level

A string indicating the taxonomic level to aggregate functions by (e.g., `"Genus"`, `"Family"`). Inferred from recorded analysis settings; otherwise `"Genus"`.

group

A string specifying the sample metadata column used for grouping in boxplots.

kegg_map

Optional PICRUSt2 mapping TSV or named member list. Defaults to the mapping recorded in the SDAA result or the package reference.

Value

A named list of `ggplot2` boxplot objects, one for each taxon with matching functional results.

Details

This function:

  • Parses PICRUSt2 stratified output and maps ASVs to their taxonomic levels.

  • Aggregates function abundances at the taxon level.

  • Filters and matches functions found in the user-provided differential result per taxon.

  • Generates and returns a list of ggplot boxplots of function abundance by group.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot_list <- tax2fun_box(
  stratified_path = "ko_metagenome_out/pred_metagenome_contrib.tsv",
  pathway_sdaa_result = diff_results,
  physeq = my_phyloseq,
  taxon_level = NULL,
  group = "disease_status"
)
plot_list$Bacteroides  # View boxplot for Bacteroides genus
} # }
